# Lab 9.2: BigQuery DataFrames (bigframes.pandas)

## What We Are Going to Do
Use pandas-style code that runs inside BigQuery, and compare it with downloading the same data into normal pandas.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Read a table with BigQuery DataFrames.**

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `read_gbq` | Lazy, nothing downloaded |
| Operations | Turned into SQL and run in BigQuery |
| `.to_pandas()` | Downloads only the final result |
| Memory | Tiny in BigQuery DataFrames, large in pandas |
